method.wls: registered fit (heavyhex.simulation.noisy.fit_per_round), re-implemented; matches the stored values to 1e-12
method.binomial: k_n ~ Binomial(N, P(n)) at all six n; A profiled exactly (concave) on [0, 1/(1-2eps)); 68.27% profile-likelihood interval where 2 (lmax - l(eps)) <= 1; 'quasi' interval uses <= phi with phi = max(1, Pearson X^2/4), the analogue of the registered sqrt(chi2_red) widening; se = half-width of an interval
method.lambda: binomial Λ = eps3/eps5 from the joint likelihood of the two independent curves, profiled over eps5 (quasi: each curve's log-likelihood divided by its phi); bootstrap: ratio of independent replicates
method.bootstrap: parametric, 2000 replicates per curve drawn from the binomial MLE curve; 68% percentile interval; bias = replicate mean - MLE value used to generate
method.pooling: inverse-variance mean, se widened by sqrt(chi2/dof) if > 1, Student t(9) bar (registered rule); binomial uses quasi half-widths as sigmas
method.predictions: stored per-round P(n) from analysis.json (200k simulated shots; each-qubit f 50k) and prediction.json (f=0, f=1; 200k), counts = round(P N), fitted with both estimators
